_comment: Post-acceptance welcome email (sent when a new user accepts the MorphoCloud org invitation; sender = the acceptance-detection job, FROM no-reply@morphocloud.org). Body is HTML; {{name}} is the only placeholder. Edits go live on the next send.
welcome_subject: Welcome to MorphoCloud — Important Next Steps
welcome_body:
Dear {{name}},

Welcome to MorphoCloud! From now on, you can create and manage your instance on your own. This email is a quick introduction — you may want to keep it handy until you are comfortable with the MorphoCloud workflow.

The basic steps you will always follow:

  1. Always start at morphocloud.org instead of GitHub. The landing page shows useful information such as live instance availability and banners about service issues or upcoming outages. From there, click "Instance Management" to go to the central issues page, where all open MorphoCloud instances are displayed.
  2. Open an instance request (green New issue button → Individual Instance Request), pick a flavor — we advise the default, g3.large — and press Create. That only opens your request; your instance isn't built (a.k.a. provisioned) yet.
  3. We use GitHub's issue comments to manage instances. To distinguish MorphoCloud commands from ordinary comments, commands are prefixed with a forward slash (/). For example, to build your instance, type /create in the comment box and press the green "Comment" button. The bot will show its progress (about 10 minutes), and when it becomes ready to be used, your connection details will arrive in this inbox.

After that, the bot will guide you on what your next actions can be. For example, when you are done for the day, comment /shelve to shut down your instance; next time you want to use it, simply comment /unshelve to restart it. Creating an instance is usually a one-time event — the only time you may want to delete and re-create it is if it ends up in an inaccessible state.

If you get stuck at any point, the User Guide has step-by-step instructions, including where your files are stored, how to transfer data between your local computer and your MorphoCloud instance, session time limits, and how long you can keep your instance. You can always reach us at portal@morphocloud.org, or ping us right on your issue page by commenting @MorphoCloud/morphocloud-admins followed by your message.

A note about emails: when you signed up for GitHub, you registered an email address, which may or may not be the one you registered with MorphoCloud. GitHub will independently send notifications to that address about your issues and the actions taken on them — for example, each time the bot comments or updates your request. You can safely disregard those, or turn them off entirely in GitHub's notification settings. The authoritative emails about your instance (credentials when it comes online, upcoming outages, etc.) will always come from no-reply@morphocloud.org — add it to your safe senders so nothing lands in spam.

Welcome aboard!
The MorphoCloud Team
